title: Client Document Collection and Follow-Up Agent
summary: A WhatsApp and email agent that sends each client their pending-document list, recognises what they upload, follows up on schedule and shows the team exactly what is still missing.

seo.title: Client Document Collection Agent for CA Firms | VipraTech
seo.description: WhatsApp and email agent for CA firms that requests PBC, GST and ITR documents, checks uploads, sends reminders and tracks what is still missing.

problem.intro: Many delays in a CA practice come from waiting for the client. PBC lists for audits, monthly purchase bills for GST, bank statements for bookkeeping and Form 16s for ITR are requested by email, then chased by phone and WhatsApp from staff members' personal numbers, with no single view of what has arrived.

pain_points.title: Chasing eats staff time
pain_points.detail: Seniors and articled assistants spend hours each week sending the same reminders and checking inboxes for replies.

pain_points.title: Clients send the wrong thing
pain_points.detail: Wrong period, wrong entity, half-page photos and password-protected PDFs without the password all need another round.

pain_points.title: No status view
pain_points.detail: Partners learn which client is blocking which engagement only when a deadline is close.

pain_points.title: History on personal phones
pain_points.detail: When an article leaves, the client conversation and documents on their WhatsApp leave with them.

solution.overview: We build a collection agent that works from the checklist for each engagement, such as the audit PBC list, the monthly GST and bookkeeping set or the ITR document list, and runs follow-ups on the firm's WhatsApp Business number and email. Each client contact gets a short message listing exactly what is pending, in English or Hindi. When documents arrive, the agent classifies them, checks the basics, such as entity, period, legibility and password, and ticks them off or asks for a correction. Reminders follow a schedule the partner sets, escalating to the engagement manager as a deadline nears. The team sees one status board per engagement.
capabilities: Engagement checklists for audit PBC, monthly GST and bookkeeping, TDS and ITR seasons
WhatsApp Business and email messaging from the firm's number, in English and Hindi
Document recognition and basic checks for type, entity, period, legibility and password
Scheduled reminders with quiet hours and escalation rules set by the partner
Optional reminder call by a voice agent for clients who do not respond to messages
Status board per client and engagement, with files saved to the right folder

workflow.title: Load the checklist
workflow.detail: The engagement checklist, client contacts, preferred language and deadlines are set up.

workflow.title: Send the pending list
workflow.detail: Each contact receives an approved message listing exactly what is outstanding.

workflow.title: Receive and check documents
workflow.detail: Uploads are classified and checked for entity, period, legibility and password.

workflow.title: Ask for corrections
workflow.detail: Documents that fail a check trigger a specific request back to the client.

workflow.title: Remind and escalate
workflow.detail: Reminders continue on the partner's schedule, and items still pending near a deadline go to the engagement manager.

workflow.title: Update the status board
workflow.detail: Accepted documents are filed and the board shows what is complete and what is blocking work.

inputs: Engagement checklists such as PBC, GST and ITR lists
Message templates approved by the partner
outputs: Pending list per client and engagement
Documents filed in the correct folders
Escalation alerts for the engagement manager
Log of messages sent and documents received
human_in_the_loop: Partners approve message templates, reminder frequency and escalation rules before anything is sent. Any client reply that is not a document, such as a question, a complaint or a fee discussion, is handed to the assigned staff member instead of being answered by the agent.
integrations: Google Drive, OneDrive or the firm's document management system
guardrails: Only partner-approved templates for business-initiated messages
Quiet hours and reminder caps per client
The agent never gives tax advice or discusses fees
Documents stored in firm storage, not on personal phones
compliance_notes: Business-initiated WhatsApp messages use approved templates and require the client's opt-in under Meta's platform policies.
Client documents contain personal data; storage and retention are designed to support DPDP Act 2023 obligations.

pilot.scope: One engagement type, such as monthly GST document collection, for a group of willing clients on the firm's WhatsApp Business number.
deliverables: Checklist and template set for the pilot engagement type
Working agent on WhatsApp and email
Status board for the pilot clients
Pilot report with client and staff feedback

what_we_measure.metric: Time to a complete document set
what_we_measure.how: Days from first request to all items received, compared with recent periods.
Messages sent before each client's set was complete.
Uploads rejected at the first check, by reason, to tune instructions to clients.
Time logged by staff on chasing, before and during the pilot.

faqs.q: Will clients find automated reminders annoying?
faqs.a: The partner sets the cadence, quiet hours and tone, and each message lists exactly what is pending rather than sending generic nudges. Clients can reply to reach a person at any time, and opt-outs are respected.

faqs.q: Can we use our existing WhatsApp number?
faqs.a: A number used on the regular WhatsApp app has to be moved to the WhatsApp Business Platform, or you can register a new number for the firm. We help with the template approvals Meta requires.
English and Hindi by default, with templates in other languages if your clients prefer. Each template is approved by the partner before use.

faqs.q: What happens if a client asks a tax question?
faqs.a: The agent does not answer it. Any message that is not a document upload is passed to the assigned staff member with the conversation history.
